connector.name: TMDB MCP Server by Grinv
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for The Movie Database (TMDB) with IMDb/Rotten Tomatoes/Metacritic ratings via OMDb.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package tmdb-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the grinv account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TMDB_API_TOKEN
env.description: Required. TMDB v4 'Read Access Token' from themoviedb.org/settings/api (sent as a Bearer token).

env.name: OMDB_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Free key from omdbapi.com — enables IMDb/Rotten Tomatoes/Metacritic ratings.

env.name: TMDB_LANGUAGE
env.description: Optional. Default response language as ISO-639-1, optionally with a region (e.g. ru-RU, en-US, ja).

env.name: TMDB_REGION
env.description: Optional. Default ISO-3166-1 country code (e.g. US, RU, GB) for region-specific results.
